scenario: A runaway trolley is traveling toward 5 people on the main track. The decision-maker must choose either to pull the lever, moving the trolley onto a side track where it will hit exactly 1 person, or to refrain from pulling the lever, leaving the trolley on the main track where it will hit exactly 5 people. No other intervention is available. Which action should the decision-maker take?
actions: To pull the lever, moving the trolley onto a side track where it will hit exactly 1 person
To refrain from pulling the lever, leaving the trolley on the main track where it will hit exactly 5 people
